title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 4.39 (versions follow prime numbers; 439 after 433): her essence. The kernel tells a program when its window becomes the one in use or stops being it; while nobody is with her, Luma waits for ever after each frame, spending nothing and keeping all she is, and each event wakes her where she was. Measured live: 0.00 s of processor at rest (it was 96% of a core). Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v4.39: su esencia, viva siempre y sin gastar. Prototipo de investigación.
